description.value: ʔuuʔinmitis Conservancy is a protected nature reserve on Vancouver Island managed by BC Parks, with a name drawn from the Nuu-chah-nulth language reflecting the area's deep Indigenous cultural significance. As a conservancy rather than a developed provincial park, it preserves coastal wilderness in one of the more remote stretches of the island's west coast. Touring cyclists exploring the region may find it a worthwhile destination for its wild character.
